Akansh Dhull has achieved the All India Rank (AIR) 3 in the UPSC Civil Services Examination (CSE) 2025, becoming one of the best-performing candidates in the most prestigious competitive examination in the country. The final results were announced by the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) on 6 March 2026, when Anuj Agnihotri topped the list with AIR 1, followed by AIR 2 for the candidate named Rajeshwari Suve M, and finally, Akansh Dhull achieved the AIR 3 position.

The success story of Akansh is an inspiring anecdote for thousands of aspirants because he opted to leave behind the lucrative campus placement offers from Shri Ram College of Commerce (SRCC) to fulfill his childhood dream of becoming a civil servant.

Early Life and Background

Akansh Dhull was born in Rohtak, Haryana , but his family later moved to Panchkula . He completed his schooling in Chandigarh , studying in two different schools before moving to Delhi for higher education.

His family played an important role in encouraging his academic ambitions. In interviews, Akansh mentioned that his mother is a school principal , and his parents motivated him to aim for civil services.
Educational Background
Akansh Dhull pursued his graduation from Shri Ram College of Commerce (SRCC), University of Delhi , one of India’s most prestigious colleges for commerce and economics.
He completed B.Com (Honours) from SRCC, where he built a strong academic foundation and developed analytical thinking skills.
Despite having the opportunity to sit for campus placements , Akansh decided to skip them because his ultimate goal was to prepare for the UPSC Civil Services Examination .

Motivation Behind Choosing Civil Services
In interviews with coaching institutes, Akansh Dhull explained why he chose civil services as a career.

According to him, civil services provide a unique opportunity to bring real change in society . Coming from Haryana, he saw firsthand how administrative decisions influence people’s lives, which motivated him to pursue this path.
His parents also encouraged him to take the UPSC route because of his strong academic performance.
